column3: (Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
(Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field)
(Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: set at the TLS edge, docs/security.md#https; absent over plain HTTP)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing: no cross-origin isolation is needed, the pages load nothing from another origin; reported, not required)
(HTTP Only Site: the local stack is plain HTTP; TLS is the edge's, deploy/vps/Caddyfile)
(A Server Error response code: the stack runs without email, so password recovery answers its documented 503)
(Unexpected Content-Type: the API scan also requests the landing's pages, answered as HTML by design)
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: nothing sets a cookie; sessions are tokens the app keeps, docs/adr/0007-mobile-sessions-with-refresh-tokens-in-the-body.md)
(Timestamp Disclosure: hashed asset names and epoch-like numbers in the stylesheets)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: the landing ships no JavaScript; a comment in its HTML is worth a look)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: informational, caching is deliberate)
